{{Short description|Annual association football award event in France}} {{Infobox award | name = 2000 Ballon d'Or | image = Luis Figo.jpg | image_size = | alt = | caption = 2000 Ballon d'Or winner, Luís Figo in 2006 | date = 19 December 2000 | location = | presenter = ''[[France Football]]'' | host = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner = {{flagicon|POR}} [[Luís Figo]] (1st award) | award2_type = | award2_winner = | award3_type = | award3_winner = | award4_type = | award4_winner = | award5_type = | award5_winner = | previous = [[1999 Ballon d'Or|1999]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2001 Ballon d'Or|2001]] }} The '''2000 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2000 Golden Ball'''}}), given to the best [[Association football|football]] player in Europe as judged by a panel of sports journalists from [[UEFA]] member countries, was awarded to [[Luís Figo]] on 19 December 2000.{{Cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/europa-poy00.html |title=European Footballer of the Year ("Ballon d'Or") 2000 |first=José Luis |last=Pierrend |publisher=[[Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|RSSSF]] |date=26 March 2005 |accessdate=27 February 2009 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090216092542/http://rsssf.com/miscellaneous/europa-poy00.html |archivedate=16 February 2009 | url-status= live}} Figo was the second Portuguese player to win the award after [[Eusébio]] ([[1965 Ballon d'Or|1965]]). He was also the third [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] player to win the trophy after [[Alfredo Di Stéfano]] (1957, 1959) and [[Raymond Kopa]] (1958).{{Cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/europa-poy.html |title=European Footballer of the Year ("Ballon d'Or") |publisher=[[Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|RSSSF]] |date=16 January 2009 |accessdate=27 February 2009 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090212081244/http://rsssf.com/miscellaneous/europa-poy.html |archivedate=12 February 2009 | url-status= live}} ==Rankings== On 13 November 2000, the shortlist of 50 male players compiled by a group of experts from ''[[France Football]]'' was announced.{{Cite web |title=Os candidatos à Bola de Ouro |url=https://maisfutebol.iol.pt/internacional/geral/os-candidatos-a-bola-de-ouro |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=Maisfutebol |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2000-11-14 |title=Francia dominancia az Aranylabdára jelöltek között |url=https://www.origo.hu/sport/sport-futball/2000/11/20001114francia |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=ORIGO |language=hu}} [[File:FigoBallond'Or2000.jpg|thumb|Luís Figo's Ballon d'Or replica]] The voting results went as follows:{{Cite web |title=France Football |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/ballon_or/bo_2000.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051101012835/http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/ballon_or/bo_2000.html |archive-date=2005-11-01 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=www.francefootball.fr}} {| class="wikitable" !Rank !Player !Club(s) !Nationality !Points |- style="background-color: #FFF68F; font-weight: bold;" | 1 || [[ Luís Figo]] ||align="left"|{{flagicon|ESP}} [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]
